inductive TransitionTree (states : Nat) where

def TransitionTree.lookup {n : Nat} : TransitionTree n → Nat → (Action n × Action n)
  | .leaf row, _ => row
  | .branch even odd, q =>
    if q % 2 = 0 then even.lookup (q / 2) else odd.lookup (q / 2)
